header.subtitle: JA4 fingerprint reputation, ASN/CIDR reputation, and the built-in JA4 corpus. Feed paths are stored in the server configuration and take effect after a worker restart.

ja4.paths.heading: JA4 reputation feed paths
ja4.paths.help: Colon-separated paths to JA4 threat-intelligence feed files. The backend hot-reloads when a file changes; adding or removing paths requires a worker restart.
asn.paths.heading: ASN reputation feed paths
asn.paths.help: Colon-separated paths to ASN/CIDR threat-intelligence feed files. AS-keyed entries require a GeoIP ASN database; CIDR entries always match.
editor.help: Colon-separated paths. Leave all rows blank to disable. Changes are saved to the server configuration and take effect after a worker restart.
